name: browser-console-errors
goal: Normal browser evidence flows have no unexpected console errors; intentional error tests preserve and assert diagnostics

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Normal success flows must have zero unexpected console.error/pageerror events; exact intentional failures retain diagnostics. Scope recorded in browser-console-errors feature spec.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: bun x vitest run test/browser-console-errors.test.ts test/browser-console-errors.e2e.test.ts failed 3 tests on unchanged implementation. Real generated Chromium flows with console errors, uncaught exception and popup error exited 0; assertion expected exit 1 got 0.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Installed shared automatic error checks in Harness browser specs and generated app/E2E/resource scaffolds; exact intentional errors preserve diagnostics and have test-scoped reasons.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged generated-browser regression now rejects console errors, uncaught exceptions and popup errors and passes when those errors disappear. Focused tests and 428 existing browser cases passed.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Focused browser error, bucket activity, and lazy fixture proofs pass. Full verification remains pending: reports-concurrent-runs.e2e.test.ts times out at its unchanged 180-second history-seeding assertion on both this implementation and isolated baseline ff47c377, before browser results.
